activation.primary: basis present after accepted delta / actual model generations; active and deferred separate
activation.projection: basis present before generation / actual model generations; needs_recheck projected status separate
activation.null_delta: not automatically inactive; may retain a prior basis

churn.denominator: turns with basis after accepted delta

adoption.valid: current actual request delivery or legally continued exact ref

manual_basis_and_gap_review.sample: every distinct accepted semantic Basis in the declared small runs
manual_basis_and_gap_review.decision: action-relevant current judgment, not task summary or pure memory transcription
manual_basis_and_gap_review.gap: different plausible resolutions change next meaningful action, its parameters or whether to act

recheck.success: a new version alone is not success; require actual ordinary request, new relevant material and accepted Host delta

cost.context_tokens: tokenizer count of exact Decision Context text; distinguish fragment tokens from billed full input
cost.delta_tokens: tokenizer count of original response decision_delta field text; no claim of additive exact billing across BPE boundaries
cost.ordinary_react_requests: report all actual iterations/rejections/recovery separately; may differ from v16
cost.prior_reference: v16 sealed ledger, no new full B1 real repeat by default

go_pivot_kill: Apply plan sections 34/35 to observed sparse activation, nonzero selective valid adoption, reachable real controlled/natural recheck, cost and ordinary-task behavior; no numerical score win or method-benefit claim. Qualitative judgments must cite actual trajectories and limitations.
